_comment: Roofed and lightless. It names no fog or sky colour: in 26.1 a biome carries its own, and naming them pinned the nether's fog to one dull colour for every biome (Jonah, 2026-08-14, walked, twice). `ambient_light_color` is #302821, the nether's own, this being the world it restates — that dim warm floor is why the nether is never truly black, and it is an attribute rather than the `ambient_light` float below, which the lightmap never reads. A zero-alpha cloud colour stays, being the only way to skip the cloud pass at all.
